职位描述：
Mainly on Production JIRA/Confluence Operation and internal Cloud Platform Support
The DevOps Supporter aims to help better coordination among operations, development, and testing functions by automating the integration and deployment processes. In addition, a good DevOps Engineer is often to better align IT operations in/cross our departments. He / She also provides technology refreshment to existing products and prepares program specification, functional specification and testing plans for projects. Ability on Research and Development is a plus.

职位要求：
1) Problem solving skills. Detail-oriented, patient and positive attitude

2) Hands on experience on at least one public cloud technology and container technology, e.g. Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, AlibabaCloud, Huawei Cloud etc.

3) Hands on experience on Linux

4) Familiar with a least one programming language, e.g. c/c++, Java, Python, Ruby, Go, etc.
Mandarin speaking
Cantonese speaking
English reading and writing
Bachelor Degree
